entities.summary: Beni Lar is a politician of the People's Democratic Party from Plateau State, Nigeria. She was a member of the Nigeria House of Representatives from Langtang North, Langtang South federal Constituency of Plateau State. She was first elected to the house in 2007 and in 2019, she was re-elected to a fourth term in the house.
